chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Abu Basir, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), who said: I heard him say:

Whoever prays four units of prayer reciting Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad two hundred times -- fifty times in each unit -- he will not finish the prayer while there remains any sin between him and God, Mighty and Majestic, except that it will be forgiven for him.

key_terms.ركعات: Units of prayer (rak'at), each consisting of standing, bowing, and two prostrations
key_terms.غفر: Forgiveness; divine pardon and erasure of sins
key_terms.قل هو الله أحد: The opening of Surah al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112), affirming divine unity

ai.seo_question: What is the prayer that guarantees forgiveness of all sins according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describes a special prayer of four units in which Surah al-Ikhlas is recited fifty times per unit, totaling two hundred recitations. This prayer guarantees complete forgiveness of all sins. The teaching was narrated through Abu Basir, one of the Imam's closest companions, in the context of devotional practices that bring believers closer to divine mercy.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from `Ali b. al-Hakam from Muthanna al-Hannat from Abi Basir from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said: I heard him say:
Whoever prays four units with two hundred recitations of qul huwallahu ahad – fifty times per unit – there will not remain a sin between him and Allah except that it has been forgiven for him.
